Finance Department Mission Statement
To provide reliable, efficient, and accurate departmental support to the agency
To serve people with compassion and understanding
To establish internal controls that safeguard the county's assets
To act with integrity, professionalism, and respect at all times
Finance Department Organizational Chart
Duties & Responsibilities
The Financial Services Department is responsible for all phases of County budget planning, preparation, and monitoring. Duties of this office include:
Performs accounting and payroll services
Financial management
Capital improvement planning
Debt financing
Fixed asset inventory
Insurance management
Grant Management
